title: Uttam Vidya
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Uttam Vidya" where he says, even if gold is lying in a dirty place, no one leaves it, similarly knowledge, even if possessed by a lowly person, should be accepted.

title: Jaati Na Poocho
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Jaati Na Poocho" where he says, just as the value of a sword is judged on the basis of its edge and not on sheath, in the same way knowledge should be given priority over caste.

title: Jo Rahim Uttam Prakrit
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the importance of having a strong character and dignity and explains this in a poignant analogy through Rahim's Doha "Jo Rahim Uttam Prakrit".

title: Rahiman Kathin
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Kathin" where he says, anxiety is worse than a pyre. The pyre burns the dead, while worry keeps burning the living.

title: Thour Chhute
desc: Moving away from our roots is a popular sentiment today. Javed Akhtar through Vrind's doha "Thour Chhute" says that as much as a person knows English, he must also know his mother tongue.
